notes: The Western Xia was proclaimed in 1038; the Tanguts already ruled the Ordos.
Added the Kara-Khanids (who took Bukhara in 999), Qocho and Khotan.
Greenland: only the Norse settlements (c. 985–1450) are shown, not the whole ice sheet.
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
The Khitan homeland was the Liao Empire.
"Denmark-Norway" is the name of the union of 1524-1814; in 1000 Norway was under Danish overlordship.
The Moche culture ended about 800; the north coast is the Sicán (Lambayeque) culture.
